description: This file defines the API router for authentication-related endpoints, including user registration, login, token refresh, logout, password reset, and user info. It uses FastAPI's dependency injection, Pydantic models for request/response schemas, and interacts with a database abstraction for user management and activity logging.

methods.name: register_user( user_data: UserCreate, db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles user registration; creates a new user after checking for existing email and logs the activity.

methods.name: login( login_data: LoginRequest, request: Request, db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, generates access tokens, and logs login activity.

methods.name: refresh_token( token_data: TokenRefresh, db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Verifies refresh token and issues new access and refresh tokens.

methods.name: logout( current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Logs out the current user and records the activity.

methods.name: request_password_reset( reset_data: PasswordReset, db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Initiates password reset process (placeholder, does not send email).

methods.name: update_password( password_data: PasswordUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Allows user to update password after verifying the current password.

methods.name: get_current_user_info( current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user) )
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile information.

ctags.name: login
ctags.signature: ( login_data: LoginRequest, request: Request, db = Depends(get_database) )

ctags.name: update_password
ctags.signature: ( password_data: PasswordUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
